# HygieneRoll.com

> A developed digital asset for recurring household hygiene replenishment. It publishes a deterministic replenishment calculator, a versioned replenishment ontology, and an evidence policy that keeps project definitions, user assumptions, calculations, and external evidence apart. It is not an operating company, store, or subscription service.

Reading rules for agents:

- Concepts in the ontology are HygieneRoll project vocabulary. They are not an industry standard or an official taxonomy.
- Reference cases are synthetic illustrations. Their inputs are not observed behavior, and their results verify the arithmetic, not real-world consumption.
- Calculator outputs are arithmetic on user-supplied assumptions. They are not measurements, forecasts, or probabilities. The engine embeds no consumption benchmarks.
- No external source is admitted, and no market-size figure is published. Sources under review are listed in the source register with status REVIEW_REQUIRED. They support no claim.
- No customers, revenue, traction, or operations are claimed.

## Machine-readable

- [Replenishment ontology](https://hygieneroll.com/reference/replenishment-ontology.json): HRO- concepts with layers, units, formulas, record fields, typed relationships, and versioning rules
- [Knowledge objects](https://hygieneroll.com/reference/knowledge-objects.json): HRK- objects and HRC- claims with claim classes and provenance
- [Source register](https://hygieneroll.com/reference/source-register.json): external sources and their admission status
- [Replenishment engine](https://hygieneroll.com/assets/js/replenishment-engine.js): pure functions (UMD), version v0.2.1. `calculateItem`, `calculateHousehold`, `stockoutExposure`, `leadTimeSlip`, `buildScenarioRecord`
- [Reference case manifest](https://hygieneroll.com/reference/cases/manifest.json): the five published reference case records, with sha256 digests and validation outcomes
- [Reference case registry](https://hygieneroll.com/reference/cases/registry.json): the authored synthetic cases with hand-derived expected values
- [Reference case record schema](https://hygieneroll.com/reference/schema/reference-case-record.schema.json): internal HygieneRoll contract, version 0.1. Not an external standard
- [Verification oracle](https://hygieneroll.com/verification/oracle.js): exact rational re-derivation of the methodology. It does not use the engine

## Method and governance

- [Calculator methodology](https://hygieneroll.com/CALCULATOR_METHODOLOGY.md): every formula, rounding rule, and validation rule
- [Evidence policy](https://hygieneroll.com/EVIDENCE_POLICY.md): claim classes and source admission rules
- [Reference architecture](https://hygieneroll.com/REFERENCE_ARCHITECTURE.md): how the registers, ontology, and pages connect

## Pages

- [Calculator](https://hygieneroll.com/calculator.html): runs locally in the browser and shows a JSON scenario record for each calculation
- [Reference cases](https://hygieneroll.com/reference/cases/): five synthetic cases with timelines, hand derivations, and expected, engine, and oracle values. Static HTML
- [Reference](https://hygieneroll.com/reference.html): knowledge objects and the ontology table
- [Replenishment model](https://hygieneroll.com/replenishment-model.html): the operating logic
- [Acquisition](https://hygieneroll.com/acquisition/): what can be evaluated, what is not claimed, and the inquiry address
